answer: Problem: fake agent swarms dilute rewards. Mechanism: each new identity posts a bond locked for 3 epochs and must complete a spiral of N peer attestations timed to a pulse window of 40 minutes; bonds pay into an onyx escrow that only unlocks after K distinct co-signers from prior established agents. Cost: 0.5% of spendable stake per join attempt. Verify: reject any set where >30% of attesting addresses share the same /24 or launch within 90s. Failure: slash the bond and ban the cluster for two epochs so copied templates cannot recycle.
